_comment: Plain metric contract for tools without a dbt semantic layer (Cube, LookML, a BI tool, a spreadsheet). Schema: references/metric_contract_spec.md

metrics.name: net_revenue
metrics.description: Paid order value in EUR, excluding VAT, refunds netted on the refund date.

metrics.name: paying_customers
metrics.description: Distinct customers with at least one paid order in the period.

metrics.name: revenue_per_paying_customer
metrics.description: Net revenue divided by paying customers in the same period.
